content:
Talia Benson: quick check-in on unit econ dashboard UI progress + rollout plan. can we align on internal demo timing today?

Marissa Cole: yep. current plan is keep it behind internal flag through next week, but want to confirm eng readiness + what we’ll show.

Chloe Martin: UI is mostly wired up in Console staging. Filters (model/region/tier) working + deep links are in. Still polishing empty/error states.

Alicia Perez: designs for empty/loading/error are done. I dropped latest in Figma yesterday. main thing: how we message “data freshness lag” vs “no data for slice”.

Felix Schneider: backend endpoints are stable for the main charts. query perf is ok for typical slices, but if you pick “All models” + “All regions” + 90d, it’s slow. we added pagination for tables but charts still heavy.

Thomas Baird: +1. we need the guardrails in before we let wider folks loose. recommend hard cap on date range for high-cardinality combos + server-side caching by (model,region,tier,window).

Logan Wright: data side: daily aggregate dataset is landing on time in prod; the UI is reading from the semantic view. biggest risk is late partitions changing yesterday’s numbers (we’re excluding last 2 hours right now).

Allison Grant: from SRE perspective: I’m fine with internal demo even if late-data handling isn’t perfect, but rollout should be staged. do we have an alert if the view is stale / missing partitions?

Aisha Bello: alerts exist in observability-pack, but not fully wired to #eng-sre yet. I can get that hooked up today. thresholds: freshness > 2h warning, > 6h page. recon variance > 1.5% warning, > 3% page.

Priya Natarajan: ok. gating items for rollout: (1) perf guardrails (2) freshness banner + link to status (3) access control for discount-sensitive views. do we have #3 in this PR or later?

Chloe Martin: access control isn’t in the UI PR. current screens don’t expose discount/credit impacts. it’s blended cost + mix shifts only. if we add “net of credits” later, we’ll need RBAC.

Marissa Cole: for demo, we can explicitly say “discount-impact views are deferred / finance-only later”. MVP is blended cost, drivers, cache hit impact, and slice by tier.

Felix Schneider: feature flag is `unit_econ_dashboard_internal` (Console). currently enabled for `@redwood.com` in staging only. I can flip for a small prod allowlist.

Talia Benson: what’s the proposed allowlist for week 1? finance + product leads + the eng folks?

Marissa Cole: suggest: Laura, Rishi, Logan, Nadia, Cole S, me, Nikhil, Aditya, Priya. basically stakeholders only.

Allison Grant: pls include me + Aisha for day 1 so we can watch alerts + see if people hit perf cliffs.

Thomas Baird: also pls add me; i want to see what filter combos people actually try so we can tune the guardrails.

Alicia Perez: demo agenda: (1) landing page: blended $/1M output tokens trend (2) drilldown to model family (3) compare regions (4) explain panel + attribution (even if v0) (5) export CSV.

Chloe Martin: explain panel is in but currently basic: shows top 3 drivers (model mix, region mix, cache hit) as a breakdown with links to the slice. doesn’t do full decomposition yet.

Marissa Cole: that’s fine for internal demo. we should be clear it’s directional / not “finance-grade” attribution until we validate.

Logan Wright: on export: CSV export works for the table; chart export is screenshot only right now. any strong need for chart data export for demo?

Marissa Cole: table CSV is enough for now. finance mostly wants to take slices into their own sheets.

Talia Benson: demo timing — can we do Thu 1pm PT? 30 min. I’ll send invite.

Priya Natarajan: Thu 1pm PT works.

Allison Grant: works. if allowlist goes live before then, can we get a quick “how to break it” note so we can pre-test?

Felix Schneider: yep. I’ll post a checklist here: worst-case filters, expected latency, and what error states look like.

Aisha Bello: once prod allowlist is on, I’ll watch the freshness + recon dashboards and report any weirdness in this thread.

Talia Benson: cool. action items: Felix enable prod allowlist + checklist; Aisha wire alerts to #eng-sre; Chloe make sure freshness/no-data banners match latest designs; Alicia send final figma link; Marissa confirm attendee list. :thumbsup:
